messages:
maria_partners: Quick heads-up: Sapphire Health signed a co-sell + AWS Marketplace listing today and agreed to a short joint case study.

neil_sales: Awesome! Any early pilot metrics we can call out?

ravi_eng: Pilot highlights: enabling per-route KV caching + a light quant profile yielded ~33% reduction in GPU-hours. p95 for claims-classifier fell from ~580ms to ~240ms on production traffic mix.

zoe_marketing: Great numbers. Do we have permission to use the Sapphire logo and a 1-line quote? Need assets for blog and social.

legal-bot: Marketing asset consent received and uploaded. Signed co-marketing SOW available in Docs.

maria_partners: Confirmed. Sapphire prefers a gated case study but ok with a short public announcement and a joint webinar.

neil_sales: Can someone assemble a 1-pager for AEs with contract highlights (procurement via marketplace, reserved capacity options, onboarding SLA)? That will help close follow-ups.

ravi_eng: I'll prepare a 2-line technical blurb and export the latency dashboard screenshot. Also will add a tiny config snippet for the caching profile.

ops-bot: task created: "Sapphire Health marketplace + case study"  assignees: zoe_marketing, ravi_eng, neil_sales. Due: 2026-10-12. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/4875

zoe_marketing: Plan: short public blog + gated technical case study + webinar in Nov. I'll draft copy and post to #marketing-review by Friday.

maria_partners: We'll mention this at the partner update and call it out in the next all-hands. Nice work team :tada:

neil_sales: Congrats everyone  big signal for our marketplace GTM.
